featured_reviews.name: Saanvi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I studied at Optimus Academy for three years while preparing for my IGCSE exams, and it played a big role in helping me achieve a great result. The teachers are extremely professional, dedicated, and truly focused on making sure students understand concepts clearly rather than just finishing the syllabus.
Whenever I had doubts while studying at home, I could message the teachers on WhatsApp and they would respond quickly and explain the solution clearly. Their constant support made studying much easier and less stressful.
The academy also conducts regular tests which helped me stay consistent and identify areas where I needed improvement. The classes are interactive and the teachers create a comfortable environment where students feel confident asking questions.
I’m very grateful to the entire team at Optimus Academy for their guidance and support throughout my IGCSE journey. Their teaching and encouragement really helped me achieve strong results.

featured_reviews.name: Zeeshan Dhakaan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My journey with Optimus Academy began in the 8th grade, and it remained an important part of my academic life throughout my IGCSE and A Level years.

What I found to be the most impressive feature of the academy is the emphasis they place on conceptual understanding. The teachers here encourage students to grasp what they are studying, not just to perform in the examinations. Being a curious student who often seeks clarification through a large number of questions, I have found the teachers to be very cooperative and understanding.

One of the greatest strengths of the academy is the method of preparation they follow. The teachers here create their own study booklets and study materials, which are very informative yet easy to read. Alongside this, the tests conducted throughout the year also help the students to be disciplined and gradually adapt to the international level of IGCSE and A-Level examinations.

Another feature of the academy is the staff members. They are very organized and cooperative.

Looking back today, I would say I am thankful for the guidance and academic structure provided by the Optimus Academy during some of the most important years of my academic life. With their guidance and  consistent support, I have been able to attain A grades in my IGCSEs and A levels.*

For students preparing for international exams, Optimus Academy offers a structured and supportive environment where students are encouraged to work hard, stay disciplined, and truly understand what they learn.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to share my personal experience with Optimus Classes conducted by Sarvesh. I found several issues that need serious attention frequent changes in class timings, lack of proper communication with parents, and no focus on students’ actual progress.
There has been no noticeable improvement in learning outcomes. The topics covered in class and the exam papers are often not aligned, which creates confusion for students.

I am personally very disappointed with his behavior and teaching approach. He seriously needs to reflect on his attitude and methods so that students’ futures are not affected any further.
